providers.name: IONOS
providers.notes: Low 1st-year promotional rates with steep 2nd-year renewal increases on shared plans; VPS plans use predictable flat monthly pricing.

providers.name: Hostinger
providers.notes: Lowest advertised monthly rates require 48-month upfront prepayment; renewals increase significantly after initial term.

providers.name: Namecheap
providers.notes: Includes cPanel on shared plans, reasonable renewal rates compared to EIG/Newfold brands, and US-based support.

providers.name: DreamHost
providers.notes: US-based WordPress-recommended host with transparent month-to-month option and custom control panel.

providers.name: Bluehost
providers.notes: Popular WordPress beginner host; requires 12–36 month upfront payment for promo pricing and renews substantially higher.

providers.name: InterServer
providers.notes: Known for its Price Lock Guarantee on Standard Web Hosting and true month-to-month billing with no renewal spike.

providers.name: SiteGround
providers.notes: Google Cloud infrastructure with strong WordPress tooling, but very high renewal rates after year 1.

providers.name: GreenGeeks
providers.notes: cPanel shared hosting with LiteSpeed and US data centers; promo requires annual/multi-year prepay.

providers.name: hosting.com (formerly A2 Hosting)
providers.notes: Developer-friendly shared & VPS hosting supporting Node.js, Python, PHP, and SSH access.

providers.name: Hetzner
providers.notes: Best-in-class price-to-performance Linux VPS with US East/West regions and zero renewal price tricks.

providers.name: Vultr
providers.notes: Hourly/monthly cloud VPS with extensive US locations, flat pricing, and IPv4/IPv6 options.

providers.name: DigitalOcean
providers.notes: Developer-friendly Droplets and App Platform with predictable flat monthly pricing.

providers.name: Akamai (Linode)
providers.notes: Reliable Linux VPS (Nanode 1GB at $5/mo flat) with 24/7 human support and no renewal hikes.

providers.name: RackNerd
providers.notes: Budget KVM VPS provider popular on LowEndBox/Reddit; annual plans often renew at the same low rate.

providers.name: OVHcloud
providers.notes: Unmetered bandwidth VPS with built-in DDoS protection and US data centers.

providers.name: Fly.io
providers.notes: Container-based edge PaaS ideal for Docker, Node.js, and Python apps; pay-as-you-go usage billing.

providers.name: Render
providers.notes: Managed PaaS for Node.js, Python, Docker, and PostgreSQL with flat monthly instance pricing.

providers.name: Cloudflare
providers.notes: Workers & Pages offer generous free tier for static/edge sites and a flat $5/mo Paid plan for serverless compute.

providers.name: BuyVM (FranTech)
providers.notes: Flat month-to-month KVM VPS slices starting at $2.00/mo with unmetered bandwidth and zero renewal hikes.

providers.name: NearlyFreeSpeech.NET
providers.notes: Pay-as-you-go PHP, MySQL, Python, and static hosting with no contracts and no renewal price spikes; small sites typically run ~$1/mo.
